key_takeaways: 이미지와 텍스트 프롬프트를 결합해 고품질 비디오를 생성하는 image-text-to-video 태스크 전용 모델

en.title: MiniMaxAI MiniMax-H3: Image-and-Text-to-Video Generation Model
en.hook: A massively adopted video generation model with over 5.5M downloads powering advanced multimodal video workflows.
key_takeaways: Supports image-text-to-video pipeline for controllable and high-fidelity video clip synthesis
Surpassed 5.5 million downloads on Hugging Face, reflecting immense community adoption and utility
Provides strong visual continuity and accurate prompt adherence across multimodal inputs
